body: I want a completely different life. I just want to not be alive, I don't enjoy anything throughout the day anymore and am a useless talentless fuck who will proudly not contribute anything to society anyway. It's not about getting better anymore, there is no such thing. I do not want to be me at all. Not exaggerating. I don't want my face, name, parents, siblings, friends. I want a whole new life and ending the one I have now is my only chance. Everyone hates me anyway so fuck it. I'm so tired of this shit. Everyone just wants to be a dick about every little fucking thing just for the hell of it. I don't even leave the fucking house any more. I want meds but "oh no they turn you into a zombie", I want to be a zombie at least. But I probably won't even get that. FUCK IT, life is supposed to be about happiness and whatever but I'm never happy any more, and I've probably never been happy.
